purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Niger State Government’s NIGIS property-registration guideline identifies a customer-service centre in Minna and describes the state property-registration process; the Niger State Planning Commission also identifies geo-mapping and modern land administration as state functions in Minna. These sources establish local/state service custody, but no safe anonymous parcel geometry route was verified. No application, payment, or map-download workflow was used.
